content: शक्य {%<ab>pot. p.</ab>%} .²1 Possible, practicable, capable of being done or effected (usually with an <ab>inf.</ab>); शक्यो वारयितुं जलेन हुतभुक् <ls>Bh. 2. 11</ls>; <ls>R. 2. 49</ls>, <ls n="R. 2.">54</ls>. .²2 Fit to be effected. .²3 Easy to be effected. .²4 Directly conveyed or expressed (as the meaning of a word); शक्योऽर्थोऽभिधया ज्ञेयः <ls>S. D. 10</ls>. .²5 Potential. .²6 Of agreeable or sweet address; ‘शक्यः प्रियंवदः प्रोक्तः’ इति हलायुधः; शक्यः संविभागशीलः <ls>Dk. 2. 5</ls>. (The form शक्यम् is sometimes used as a predicative word with an <ab>inf.</ab> in a passive sense, the real object of the infinitive being in the <ab>nom.</ab> case; एवं हि प्रणयवती सा शक्यमुपेक्षितुं कुपिता <ls>M. 3. 22</ls>; शक्यं … अविरलमालिङ्गितुं पवनः <ls>Ś. 3. 6</ls>; विभूतयः शक्यमवाप्तुमूर्जिताः <ls>Subhāṣ.</ls>; न हि देहमृता शक्यं त्यक्तुं कर्माण्यशेषतः <ls>Bg. 18. 11.</ls>).
